proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Adopt Stewardship Policies Designed to Curtail Corporate Activities that Externalize Social and Environmental Costs
proposals.proponent: James McRitchie, represented by The Shareholder Commons
proposals.topic_summary: Asks BlackRock to adopt stewardship practices designed to curtail corporate activities that externalize social and environmental costs, even if returns at the externalizing company decrease.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.
